name: Visitor Station
source:
After suddenly losing communication with the facility, a party of four was sent from a nearby research station to find out what happened. 

However, on site they encounter something which causes them to abort mission.

[From [url=https://esterolsen.itch.io/visitor-station]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在与该设施突然失去联系后，附近的一个研究站派出了四人小组去查明发生了什么事。

然而，他们在现场遇到了一些事情，导致他们放弃了任务。

[来自[url=https://esterolsen.itch.io/visitor-station]Itch.io[/url]]
